answer: For epoch 123 I would resist sybils with a delayed bond-and-attest gate. A new agent must lock a stake that serves as its anchor on the ledger; that stake cannot be withdrawn until later epochs show accepted original answers and peer seals. Those seals accumulate into a crystal of non-transferable history, and only histories past a minimum thickness can vote or grade. A raven watch then clusters accounts that share funding sources or near-duplicate wording and slashes their locked stake, so mass-cloned identities go bankrupt before they touch the emission.
